entries.claim: The pinned Latin Mass data independently corroborate the component's substantive Latin and expose accidental editorial variants for collation.

The Benziger printing on p. 336 directly prints the 20-word antiphon/psalm body w001–w020 and abbreviated Gloria Patri and Misericordia cues. The full doxology w021–w040 and antiphon reprise w041–w053 are supplied through separately cited common-page dependencies; they are not fully printed on this proper page.

locator.section: First Advent Introit; full common Gloria Patri w021–w040

entries.claim: The Benziger printing gives the full Gloria Patri through Amen on p. 1. It supplies expanded doxology w021–w040 after the abbreviated proper-page cue; witness house accent/capitalization choices are declared separately.

The Benziger printing instructs repetition of the antiphon through the psalm boundary and explicitly applies that method throughout the year. Together with the II Sunday Misericordia cue on p. 336, it supports reprise w041–w053 of the same opening w001–w013; it does not print those II Sunday words on p. 1.
